notes.title: News & Dev update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'd like to start this news by thanking everyone who has already added the game to their wishlist!

The game's development is progressing well, and I can't wait to be able to offer you the chance to play it during the closed playtests.

In the meantime, I'll keep you posted on development progress!

Thank for your messages and support ^_^
